PCA scree plot (variance explained)

Source: R/plot_scree.R
plot_scree.Rd

Plots the proportion of variance explained by each principal component, with a cumulative line. Accepts either a fitted `prcomp` object or long-format NPX data (PCA is computed internally).

Usage

plot_scree(
  x,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  sample_col = NULL,
  scale = TRUE,
  center = TRUE,
  n_pcs = 10,
  cumulative = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A `prcomp` object, an OlinkExperiment, or a data.frame in long format.

assay_col

Name of the assay column (long format). If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

value_col

Name of the NPX value column (long format). If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "NPX").

sample_col

Name of the sample ID column (long format). If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "SampleID").

scale

Logical; scale variables to unit variance before PCA (default TRUE).

center

Logical; center variables before PCA (default TRUE).

n_pcs

Number of principal components to display (default 10).

cumulative

Logical; overlay the cumulative variance line (default TRUE).

title

Plot title.

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::geom_col()`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# From long-format data
plot_scree(beatmg_npx_merged[beatmg_npx_merged$Timepoint == 1, ])

# From an existing prcomp object
pc <- prcomp(scale = TRUE, x = NULL)
plot_scree(pc)
} # }
